dataIdInfo.idPurp: Hydrologic soils from SSURGO and NATSGO within riparian buffers in each Long Island Sound COMID (catchment) in the 1:100000 National Hydrography Dataset Plus (NHDPlus). Prepared as a preprocessing step to the River Basin Export Reduction Optimization Support Tool (RBEROST) model.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: Gridded NATSGO and SSURGO data were clipped to the Long Island Sound basin, dominant hydric soil attributes from the Muaggatt table added, and the data reclassed using the dominant hydrologic soil classes. The reclassed soils data was clipped to 20-, 40-, 60-, 80-, and 100-ft riparian buffers of NHDPlus flowlines, waterbodies and water areas for use in a riparian buffer analysis. Zonal Histograms were run for each reclassed and clipped soil raster as input to 00_ProcessRiparianData-Northeast.R, code designed to produce input data for the RBEROST model. The data was processed using tools in ArcGIS Pro and a series of Python scripts (ExtractDatausingBufferMask.py, and ZonalAnalysis_SoilsNLCDSlope.py).

dataLineage.statement: Soil data from gNATSGO or gSSURGO were clipped to the study area. Hydrologic Group - Dominant Conditions (hydgrpdcd) was added to the data from the muaggatt table provided with the gNATSGO or SSURGO data. gNATSGO was used for areas in NH, NY, and VT. gSSURGO data was used for areas in CT, MA, and RI. Blanks in dataset were attributed as "NA."
